global: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows in a white bowl, topped with shredded cabbage and green herbs. The rich red broth and neatly arranged toppings contrast against a dark wooden background under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised rim, showing faint reddish seasoning residue along inner edge.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, garnished with bean sprouts and green herbs, appears rich, red-orange, and textured.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with caramelized edges and green herb specks on its surface.
